title: Project Deep Nexus
description:
About:Project Deep Nexus is a lore-rich visual novel set in the near future of 2045. You play as an exhausted employee of the collapsing tech-giant Astral World who suddenly wakes up back in 2038, during your final days of high school, with no memory of the last seven years. The school is planning a field trip to Camp Evergreen for a few days to celebrate your class’ graduation. 

You meet Lizzy and her group of friends and spend time together during the field trip doing camp activities and getting to know them. 

Everything seems to be perfect… too perfect.

Content warnings: This game contains references to oppression, censorship, loss of life, and mass loss of life. It is intended for audiences 13+.

Feature list: Single-player

Branching Narrative

Multiple Endings
description_short: You seem to have woken up in your final days of high school. You make some new friends and go on a field trip to a summer camp to celebrate your class’ graduation. However, the camp is not what it seems to be, nor are the people what they seem.
